maturity.note: usar 1d/3d para aprendizaje temprano y 5d/10d para validacion mas fuerte; no promover reglas sin evidencia suficiente

method.identity: producer_agent_contract preferred; decision agent_contract only when producer identity is unavailable; never infer from symbol/source
method.hit_definition: hit_rate_net_10bps uses signed forward return minus 10 bps > 0; gross_gt_1pct is retained as a separate historical metric; short reverses raw return; exit requires explicit position_direction
method.eligible_denominator: explicit mature outcome + return available + valid direction + source is not trade_memory
method.same_cycle_control: 10d mature signal and verified control with matching signal_id and cycle_id
method.fallback: separate from llm/deterministic; provider, model and reason retained when available
